name: format_string_to_output
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and sends each character to an output routine through an indirect call. A percent sign starts an escape that is handled by recursing into a nested pass, and the routine also calls DOS input, output and open functions and a task lookup, with a console window specification in its referenced text.

name: run_polling_dispatch_loop
description: Calls one routine and, if it returns non-zero, loops while a global flag stays clear, calling a library vector on each pass. A result of minus two selects one argument inside the loop before a dispatch call, and the loop ends when the flag becomes non-zero.

name: invoke_library_vector_from_stack
description: Loads a code pointer from a stack argument at a fixed negative offset and calls it. It has no other logic, and its recorded facts show that the call dispatches through a library base.

name: allocate_entry_block_if_empty
description: When an entry is empty or has its flag bit set, it requests a block and stores the pointer in two fields, clearing two status words on success. On failure it records a fixed error code and returns minus one; for a filled entry it returns zero without change.

name: process_active_records_backwards
description: Walks a table of six-byte records from last to first and passes each record with a non-zero low byte and a clear fourth-bit flag to a further routine. It makes one final call after the walk.

name: insert_block_into_free_list
description: Rejects non-positive sizes, then rounds the requested size up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight. It inserts the block into a sorted free list, merging with touching neighbours, and returns minus one if the block falls inside an existing free region, otherwise zero.

name: chain_calls_with_status_check
description: Calls one routine and returns minus one if it reports zero. Otherwise it calls a second routine and returns minus one when a global status word is non-zero, or that routine's result if it is not.

name: move_memory_block
description: Copies a block of bytes of the given length. When the source starts at or below the destination it copies from the end backwards so overlapping data is preserved, otherwise it copies forwards.

name: find_or_allocate_free_entry
description: Walks a linked list from a global head looking for an entry whose status word is zero. If none is free it allocates a 24-byte entry, zeroes it and links it in, then passes the entry to a further routine.

name: validate_and_clear_entry
description: Reads a flag bit in the entry and, when it is set, calls a routine to obtain a status value. It then calls another routine for entries with a non-zero pointer and clear state bits, clears the status word, and returns zero only when the earlier status was not failed and the last call returned zero.

name: copy_text_buffer_and_process
description: Copies up to 79 characters from a global pointer into a local buffer and terminates it. It looks up the current task and, if that task's field is non-zero, writes the buffer and a newline through an output routine and returns minus one; otherwise it opens a library and passes the buffer and two numeric limits to a further routine.

name: copy_break_message_and_report
description: Copies a zero-terminated message into a stack buffer and looks up the current task. If that task's field is non-zero it writes the buffer and a newline through an output routine and returns minus one; otherwise it opens a library and passes the buffer and two numeric limits onward. The referenced text is the prefix '*** Break: '.

name: open_intuition_library_and_run
description: Opens the intuition library and returns minus one if that fails. On success it stores a stack buffer in a global slot, passes it with two numeric limits to a further routine, and returns zero only when that routine reports one.

name: invoke_routine_with_fixed_limits
description: Stores a stack buffer pointer in a global slot and calls a further routine with fixed limits of 250 and 60 plus a library handle. It returns zero only when that routine reports one, and minus one otherwise.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero. It is referenced by address and called from three places.

name: clear_entry_and_check_status
description: Fetches an entry through a routine and returns minus one when none is available. For a non-flagged entry it runs a further routine, clears the entry's first word, and returns minus one only if a global error word is set; for a flagged entry it clears the word and returns zero.

name: poll_signal_callback
description: Reads the signal state through the exec library and, when the two high signal bits are set and a stored callback is present and returns non-zero, clears the callback slot and runs a further routine.

name: delegate_call_wrapper
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, with no other logic.

name: setup_audio_channel_buffers
description: Allocates a block of memory and carves it into four 68-byte channel records, then copies a sixteen-longword template into each record's buffer and sets two per-record fields. It opens the audio device as part of setup and calls a failure routine if allocation fails.

name: dispatch_command_with_fallthrough
description: Switches on a small command code whose cases fall through one another, so higher codes also run the lower cases' work. Case three sets a busy flag and spins until another routine clears it, and the default case clears a pending flag and runs a further routine.

name: queue_device_io_request
description: Fills a request block for the channel named by the second argument with the first argument's upper word, a stored pointer and a size value. If the channel is already active it first sends a spare block, then sends the pending request to the device begin-io routine, marks the channel active and swaps the current and spare request blocks.

name: submit_request_with_pointer
description: Stores the first argument as a 16-bit value in a pending request block and sets a second field from the other argument, zeroed when a global flag is set. It copies a pointer from a table indexed by the first argument into the block and sends the block to the device begin-io routine.

name: flush_pending_requests
description: Loops over four request slots and, for each one flagged as pending, copies its stored pointer into a block and sends that block to the device begin-io routine. It clears each slot's pending flag after sending.

name: complete_pending_slot_request
description: For one slot marked pending, clears a field in its block, copies the stored pointer in and sends it to the device begin-io routine. It then clears the pending flag and sets a per-slot counter to 100.

name: read_packed_numeric_pair
description: Reads two numeric values and combines them into one packed 32-bit result, scaling the first value's tens into hundreds. When a read fails it reports an error through a message routine whose referenced text includes a 'can't open' string, and returns zero.

name: allocate_memory_or_fail
description: Calls the exec memory-allocation vector and, if it returns null, calls a failure routine. It returns the allocation result unchanged.

name: open_read_and_close_file
description: Opens a file through the DOS library and, if that fails, reports an error whose text includes a 'can't open' string and returns zero. On success it reads through the DOS read call, closes the handle, and returns the read result.

name: run_guarded_one_time_setup
description: Runs a setup routine only while a first status flag is clear. Within that, it runs a second routine and sets a second flag when that flag is still clear, then marks the first flag as set.

name: mark_request_slot_pending
description: Clears the length word of a request block chosen from a table by the first argument and sets its state word to one. If the second argument is non-zero it also calls a further routine.

name: update_matching_slot_state
description: If the slot selected by the first argument stores an identifier equal to the second argument and has a non-zero state word, it stores the first argument into that state word. Otherwise it leaves the slot unchanged.

name: configure_channel_from_table
description: Stores a table value in a channel's first field and doubles a second field a number of times set by the third argument. When the table entry is non-zero or the channel's stored index differs, it recomputes a scaled level from a table and passes it on.

name: update_channel_scaled_level
description: Stores a value and a position into a channel record and clears its two counters. When the channel's table entry is non-zero or its stored index differs, it recomputes a scaled level from a table and passes it to a further routine.

name: store_channel_values_and_level
description: Stores two 16-bit values into a channel record and clears two counters. It then recomputes a scaled level from a table entry when that entry is set or the stored index differs, and passes the level on.

name: index_packed_record_strings
description: Reads a count and, for each record, stores pointers to up to four segments within a packed byte stream. Each segment ends at a terminator byte of 255, and a marker byte of 239 after a segment ends the record early.

name: interpret_bytecode_opcode
description: Dispatches on a 16-bit opcode: it pushes or pops values on per-stream stacks, adds or subtracts bytes from running totals, updates tables and counters, and ignores unknown codes. Most cases read a byte from a stream pointer and advance it.

name: add_thousands_from_stream
description: Reads one byte from the stream selected by the argument, advances that stream pointer, and adds the byte times 1000 to a 16-bit total.

name: subtract_thousands_from_stream
description: Reads one byte from the selected stream, advances the stream pointer, and subtracts the byte times 1000 from a 16-bit total.

name: record_stream_position_by_byte
description: Reads the byte at the stream pointer for the index, advances the pointer by one, and stores the new pointer in a table slot chosen by that byte.

name: branch_by_nibble_counter
description: Reads a byte and uses its low four bits to pick a counter. A positive counter is decremented and the stream jumps to a table target, a negative counter is reloaded from the high four bits and the same jump is taken, and a zero counter is set to minus one and the stream advances by one byte.

name: arm_or_reload_nibble_counter
description: Uses a counter cell chosen by a nibble. A zero cell is set to minus one, while any other value is reloaded from the byte's high four bits and the stream jumps to a table target.

name: set_table_cell_and_advance
description: Stores minus one into a 16-bit cell of a two-dimensional table, located from two indices, and advances the stream pointer for the second index by one.

name: jump_or_skip_stream_byte
description: When a global flag is clear, the stream pointer for the index is replaced by the table entry chosen by the byte it points to. When the flag is set, the pointer just advances by one byte.

name: jump_stream_by_table_entry
description: Replaces the stream pointer for the index with the table entry selected by the byte currently at that pointer.

name: jump_stream_by_table_entry
description: Replaces the stream pointer for the index with the table entry selected by the byte currently at that pointer.

name: store_stream_byte_in_slot
description: Reads the byte at the stream pointer for the index, advances the pointer by one, and stores the byte as a 16-bit value in a slot for that index.

name: add_stream_byte_to_total
description: Reads a byte from the stream selected by the index, advances the pointer, and adds the byte to a global 16-bit total.

name: subtract_stream_byte_from_total
description: Reads a byte from the stream selected by the index, advances the pointer, and subtracts the byte from a global 16-bit total.

name: add_byte_to_second_total
description: Reads a byte from the selected stream, advances the pointer, and adds the byte to a second global 16-bit total.

name: subtract_byte_from_second_total
description: Reads a byte from the selected stream, advances the pointer, and subtracts the byte from a second global 16-bit total.

name: add_byte_to_index_value
description: Reads a byte from the selected stream, advances the pointer, and adds the byte to a 16-bit value kept for that index.

name: subtract_byte_from_index_value
description: Reads a byte from the selected stream, advances the pointer, and subtracts the byte from a 16-bit value kept for that index.

name: clear_active_flag
description: Sets a 16-bit state word to zero.

name: advance_stream_by_one
description: Advances the stream pointer for the given index by one byte.

name: run_streams_until_flag_clear
description: For each of four streams whose wait counter is zero, reads bytes and dispatches values below 100 through a routine, while bytes of 100 or more go to a separate routine. It repeats while a global state word is non-zero and returns once that word is cleared.

name: service_stream_slots_loop
description: Walks the four stream slots from a starting index, reading bytes from each slot that is ready, dispatching values below 100 and sending bytes of 100 or more to a separate routine. It decrements the waits of slots still waiting and stops when the global state word is cleared.

name: dispatch_next_pending_stream
description: Repeatedly finds the next stream slot whose wait counter is zero and reads a byte from it, dispatching values below 100 through a routine. It returns once no slot is left to service.

name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns.

name: step_channel_level_toward_target
description: Computes a scaled target level from a table entry and moves the channel's level toward it by the given step, or sets it directly when the step is zero. It updates a change counter and, when the level reaches zero on a flagged channel, sends a request through the device begin-io routine and sets the counter to 100.

name: set_channel_level_and_stop
description: Writes a level into a channel record and increments its change counter. When the level is zero and the channel is flagged, it sends a request through the device begin-io routine, clears the flag and sets a counter to 100.

name: set_level_table_and_stop
description: Lowers the channel's level by the given amount, or sets it to a fixed value, and increments the change counter when a table comparison shows a change. When the level is zero on a flagged channel it sends a request through the device begin-io routine, clears the flag and sets a counter to 100.

name: set_level_and_check_table
description: Writes a fixed level into a channel record and increments its change counter when a table comparison shows a change. When the level is zero on a flagged channel it sends a request through the device begin-io routine, clears the flag and sets a counter to 100.

name: set_level_stop_if_silent
description: Writes a level into a channel record and calls a routine. When the level is zero on a flagged channel it clears the change counter, sends a request through the device begin-io routine, clears the flag and sets a counter to 100.

name: adjust_channel_level_toward_table
description: Computes a scaled level from a table entry and steps the channel's level toward it by one, or advances the change counter when table entries differ. When the level is zero on a flagged channel it sends a request through the device begin-io routine and sets a counter to 100.

name: increment_counter_stop_if_done
description: Increments a channel's change counter and calls a routine. When the level is zero on a flagged channel it clears the counter, sends a request through the device begin-io routine, clears the flag and sets a second counter to 100.

name: step_channel_level_with_table
description: Lowers a channel's level by one when it is above the target, and otherwise advances its change counter when table entries differ. When the level reaches zero on a flagged channel it sends a request through the device begin-io routine and sets a counter to 100.

name: advance_channel_counter_on_change
description: Advances a channel's change counter when a table entry differs from its neighbour, then calls a routine. When the level is zero on a flagged channel it sends a request through the device begin-io routine and sets a counter to 100.

name: tick_channels_and_update_flags
description: On each tick, if the skip flag is set it clears it and returns. Otherwise a tick counter wraps modulo a divisor when armed, each of four channels with a pending countdown is decremented or has its level recomputed from a table, and a status word is set according to whether any channel remains active.

name: advance_channel_timers_tick
description: Advances a global tick counter modulo a divisor when it is active, then for each of four channels with a pending countdown it decrements the countdown or recomputes its level from a table. It sets the global activity flag according to whether any channel remains pending.

name: recompute_channel_levels_loop
description: Recomputes each active channel's level from a table, moving through the channels in order and calling a routine for each one whose countdown reaches zero. Once no channel remains it sets the activity flag from whether any channel is still active.

name: refresh_channel_levels_outer_loop
description: Loops over the channels from the first one, recomputing each level from a table and calling a routine when a level has changed. It finishes by setting the activity flag from whether any channel remains active.

name: decrement_and_advance_channel_timers
description: Decrements the countdown of one channel, then scans the following channels, decrementing waiting countdowns and recomputing levels from a table for those that are ready. It sets the activity flag from whether any channel is still active at the end.

name: update_activity_status
description: Sets a status word to zero when both a global counter and a local flag are zero. Otherwise it calls a routine and sets the status word to one.

name: clear_activity_status
description: Sets a 16-bit status word to zero.

name: initialise_if_handle_empty
description: When a stored handle is zero, it calls a routine and then passes a stored value and a buffer pointer to a second routine. When the handle is set it does nothing.

name: find_or_allocate_free_entry
description: Walks a linked list from a global head looking for an entry whose status word is zero. If none is free it allocates a 24-byte entry, zeroes it and links it in, then passes the entry to a further routine.

name: store_argument_bytes_to_global
description: Writes bytes taken from the upper half of its 32-bit argument into a global location.

name: read_bytes_from_buffer_stream
description: Copies bytes from a buffer structure into an output buffer for the given number of items, refilling the buffer through a further routine when it runs out. It stops early and returns the number of items copied when an end-of-data marker is read.

name: format_text_with_conversions
description: Copies ordinary characters from a format string to an output buffer and counts them. On a percent sign it reads the next character, looks it up in a small table of conversion codes and jumps to the matching handler.

name: open_handle_and_attach_callback
description: Sets bit two of a global flag word and opens a handle through the library. On success it fills a small structure with two byte values and a callback address, attaches it through a further routine, and returns one when that attach reports zero, otherwise zero.

name: release_device_entry_status
description: Optionally runs a routine for a flagged entry, and runs another when a pointer field is set and its state bits are clear. It then clears the entry's state word and returns zero only when those calls report success.

name: print_intui_text_item
description: Stores the requested position, using stored defaults when the first argument is minus one, and saves the text pointer. It measures the text length through the intuition library, updates the horizontal position and prints the text item.

name: drain_matching_messages
description: Fetches the next message from a port when none is held, then replies to and discards each message whose flag bits match the mask. It finally clears one state word and sets another.

name: test_point_in_rectangle
description: Returns one when the point given in two registers lies within the rectangle stored as four words, inclusive of both edges, and zero otherwise.

name: index_word_coded_display_list
description: Scans a list of 16-bit words up to a terminator of 256, recording entries in two tables by their range. It then fills a 64-entry lookup table by searching the list for entries in a fixed range, and its recorded facts also name the background colour register.

name: load_rgb_palette_entries
description: Calls the graphics library's colour-loading routine, then copies 16-bit colour entries from a fixed table into a destination array for indices from 32 up to a given limit.

name: poll_input_and_fire_button
description: Drains an input message port, latching a key code from one message class. It then samples the fire-button bit and returns 32 on a fresh press, otherwise the latched code or 255 when no press is pending.

name: adjust_palette_colour_components
description: Adds or subtracts a signed step to the red, green and blue 4-bit components of a range of 16-bit colour words, clamping each component at its limits. It then passes the result to a further routine.

name: copy_region_and_wait_frames
description: Copies a block of bytes from a table into a destination, then waits sixteen times, making two timing calls on each pass. The routine references the graphics library's frame-wait call.

name: copy_region_repeatedly_with_wait
description: Repeats ten times: copies a block of bytes from a table into a destination, then makes two timing calls and waits for a frame.

name: check_argument_is_zero
description: If its argument is non-zero it calls a failure routine with a message that names the source file amdispl.c and the condition no==0; otherwise it returns.

name: build_row_address_table
description: Writes two header words and a byte count into a record, then fills a table of row start addresses at multiples of a row size offset from a base. It then calls a further routine with the remaining data.

name: seek_to_picture_record
description: Checks that a picture index lies between 0 and 154, and on first use opens the picture library file and verifies that it holds 155 pictures. It then seeks to the picture's record and returns its length plus a fixed header size of 28.

name: read_picture_record_offsets
description: Checks a range of picture indices, seeks in the library file to read a block of 28-byte records, and fills an offset table with cumulative sizes. It returns the block's read size plus its starting offset.

name: close_picture_library_file
description: Closes the picture library file through the DOS library if it is open, and clears the stored handle.

name: report_unrecovered_routine_body
description: No pseudo-code could be produced for this one-instruction routine. Its recorded facts show that one routine calls it and that it makes one call to another routine, so its exact behaviour is not recovered.

name: call_buffer_pair_then_routine
description: Passes a stack-relative address and the address of a global data area to another routine, then makes a further call and returns.

name: multiply_32bit_via_halves
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using their 16-bit halves, combining the cross products into the upper word and returning the truncated 32-bit result.

name: load_tu0_resource_slot
description: Clears a global mode word, stores a constant in a slot, and calls a further routine to load the resource named by the referenced text 'tu0.w', storing its result in a fixed slot.

name: load_tu1_resource_slot
description: Sets a global mode word to one, stores a constant in a slot, and calls a further routine to load the resource named by the referenced text 'tu1.w', storing its result in a fixed slot.

name: delegate_call_wrapper
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns. The referenced text 'tun.env' and 'tun.ins' is the only evidence of what that routine loads.

name: delegate_call_wrapper
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns. The referenced text 'mtu.note' is the only evidence of what that routine handles.

name: clear_eight_slot_bytes
description: Clears a 16-bit counter, then zeroes eight consecutive bytes starting at a fixed offset in the global area.

name: initialise_channel_tables
description: Initialises four slots: each gets a record pointer, three cleared fields and five words set to minus one. It then clears two global words, sets two others to 15 and 4, calls a further routine, and sets a state word to 43000.

name: run_five_setup_steps
description: Makes five calls to other routines in sequence, one of which is a library-vector stub, and does nothing else.

name: delegate_call_wrapper
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, with no other logic.

name: store_argument_to_global_word
description: Stores its 16-bit argument into a fixed word of the global area.

name: run_routines_with_value_64
description: Calls another routine twice with the value 64, then calls two further routines.

name: run_routines_with_value_64
description: Calls another routine twice with the value 64, then calls two further routines.

name: run_routines_with_value_64
description: Calls another routine twice with the value 64, then calls two further routines.

name: run_routine_with_value_34
description: Calls another routine with the value 34, then calls one further routine.

name: reset_slot_states_and_counts
description: Sets a status word for each of four slots to two and fills five words of each slot with minus one, then clears two global words.

name: toggle_flag_and_copy_word
description: Flips a one-bit global flag and copies a 16-bit value from one global location to another.

name: clear_state_and_set_default
description: Sets a 16-bit state word to zero and a second word to 43000.

name: set_flag_word_to_one
description: Sets a 16-bit global flag word to one.

name: initialise_channel_state_tables
description: Sets three global 16-bit words to 60000, 1 and 64, then copies four 32-bit entries and two 16-bit table entries into their slots across four passes. It calls two routines in between and finishes by setting a state word to one.

name: allocate_memory_or_fail
description: Calls the exec memory-allocation vector and, if it returns null, calls a failure routine. It returns the allocation result unchanged.

name: read_packed_numeric_pair
description: Reads two numeric values and combines them into one packed 32-bit result, scaling the first value's tens into hundreds. When a read fails it reports an error through a message routine whose referenced text includes a 'can't open' string, and returns zero.

name: complete_pending_slot_request
description: For one slot marked pending, clears a field in its block, copies the stored pointer in and sends it to the device begin-io routine. It then clears the pending flag and sets a per-slot counter to 100.

name: run_guarded_one_time_setup
description: Runs a setup routine only while a first status flag is clear. Within that, it runs a second routine and sets a second flag when that flag is still clear, then marks the first flag as set.

name: update_matching_slot_state
description: If the slot selected by the first argument stores an identifier equal to the second argument and has a non-zero state word, it stores the first argument into that state word. Otherwise it leaves the slot unchanged.

name: mark_request_slot_pending
description: Clears the length word of a request block chosen from a table by the first argument and sets its state word to one. If the second argument is non-zero it also calls a further routine.

name: setup_audio_channel_buffers
description: Allocates a block of memory and carves it into four 68-byte channel records, then copies a sixteen-longword template into each record's buffer and sets two per-record fields. It opens the audio device as part of setup and calls a failure routine if allocation fails.

name: configure_channel_from_table
description: Stores a table value in a channel's first field and doubles a second field a number of times set by the third argument. When the table entry is non-zero or the channel's stored index differs, it recomputes a scaled level from a table and passes it on.

name: store_channel_values_and_level
description: Stores two 16-bit values into a channel record and clears two counters. It then recomputes a scaled level from a table entry when that entry is set or the stored index differs, and passes the level on.

name: open_read_and_close_file
description: Opens a file through the DOS library and, if that fails, reports an error whose text includes a 'can't open' string and returns zero. On success it reads through the DOS read call, closes the handle, and returns the read result.

name: index_packed_record_strings
description: Reads a count and, for each record, stores pointers to up to four segments within a packed byte stream. Each segment ends at a terminator byte of 255, and a marker byte of 239 after a segment ends the record early.

name: run_main_event_loop
description: Calls intuition library routines to set and clear the pointer shape and to change the IDCMP flags around a loop that repeats until a global flag is set. Each pass runs a sequence of further routines.

name: open_screen_and_window
description: Opens a custom screen and then a window on it through the intuition library, setting the window's pointer and showing the screen title. The referenced messages include 'Can't open your screen.' and 'Window painted shut.'

name: report_missing_resource
description: Calls a routine with a message containing the text 'No %s found!' and then makes two further calls.

name: open_graphics_intuition_libraries
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries through the exec library, calling a failure routine if either is missing. It writes a mask with the set bit to the interrupt-enable register, looks up the current task, saves and changes one of its fields, and returns one.

name: close_opened_libraries_and_restore
description: Clears a state word, runs three routines, restores the task field saved earlier, and closes the graphics and intuition libraries when they were opened.

name: verify_saved_file_marker
description: Calls a routine with a constant argument and, when the result is non-negative, reads a second value. It returns true only when that value equals 200, and the referenced text 'saved.tnl' names the file being checked.

name: return_zero_after_call
description: Calls another routine and then returns zero.

name: check_sinus_table_loaded
description: Looks up a constant table identifier and, when the lookup is non-negative, makes two further calls. It returns true when the lookup succeeded, and the referenced text 'sinus' names the table.

name: init_three_fixed_bitmaps
description: Initialises three bitmaps through the graphics library with fixed size arguments of 256 and 31, 88 and 52, and 165 and 5, filling four plane pointers in each.

name: delegate_call_wrapper
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, with no other logic.

name: delegate_call_wrapper
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, with no other logic.

name: init_bitmap_set_with_planes
description: Initialises several bitmaps with fixed size arguments through the graphics library, filling four plane pointers for each. It ends with a loop of six groups that repeat the same setup.

name: test_dismiss_key_pressed
description: Reads and clears a stored key code and returns one when it is 32, 27 or 255, and zero otherwise.

name: dispatch_indexed_section_entry
description: Looks up an entry in a section table using a stored index, rebuilding that section's list when the index has changed, then jumps to a routine addressed through a second table.

name: process_flagged_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list of nodes from a global head, calling a routine for each node whose second flag bit is set, whose first flag bit is clear and whose two stored values differ. It then makes one further call.

name: dispatch_indexed_section_entry
description: Looks up an entry in a section table using a stored index, rebuilding that section's list when the index has changed, then jumps to a routine addressed through a second table.

name: build_row_address_table
description: Writes two header words and a byte count into a record, then fills a table of row start addresses at multiples of a row size offset from a base. It then calls a further routine with the remaining data.

name: clear_state_and_set_default
description: Sets a 16-bit state word to zero and a second word to 43000.

name: dispatch_indexed_section_entry
description: Looks up an entry in a section table using a stored index, rebuilding that section's list when the index has changed, then jumps to a routine addressed through a second table.

name: match_key_sequence_input
description: Waits for input events and compares key codes against a stored zero-terminated sequence, tracking progress through it. It sets a result word when the sequence has been matched and then returns.

name: flush_pending_requests
description: Loops over four request slots and, for each one flagged as pending, copies its stored pointer into a block and sends that block to the device begin-io routine. It clears each slot's pending flag after sending.

name: close_picture_library_file
description: Closes the picture library file through the DOS library if it is open, and clears the stored handle.

name: dispatch_indexed_section_entry
description: Looks up an entry in a section table using a stored index, rebuilding that section's list when the index has changed, then jumps to a routine addressed through a second table.

name: clear_entry_and_check_status
description: Fetches an entry through a routine and returns minus one when none is available. For a non-flagged entry it runs a further routine, clears the entry's first word, and returns minus one only if a global error word is set; for a flagged entry it clears the word and returns zero.

name: copy_string_to_output_buffer
description: Pushes each character of a zero-terminated string into an output buffer through a routine that tracks remaining room, and returns the string length.

name: check_entry_status_flag
description: Obtains an entry through a routine and returns minus one when none is available. Otherwise it runs a second routine and returns minus one when a stored failure flag is set, or that routine's result.

name: check_entry_with_optional_step
description: Obtains an entry and, when one of its flag bits is set, runs a routine on it. It then runs a second routine and returns minus one when a stored failure flag is set, or that routine's result.

name: delegate_call_wrapper
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, with no other logic.

name: claim_slot_and_store_value
description: Searches a table for the first unused slot and returns minus one with an error code when none is free. Otherwise it normalises the mode bits of the second argument, calls routines chosen by those bits to obtain a value, and stores the slot index and value in the slot.

name: format_text_with_conversions
description: Copies ordinary characters from a format string to an output buffer and counts them. On a percent sign it reads the next character, looks it up in a small table of conversion codes and jumps to the matching handler.

name: blit_bitmap_region
description: Calls the graphics library's bitmap blit routine through the stored graphics base and returns.

name: dispatch_command_with_fallthrough
description: Switches on a small command code whose cases fall through one another, so higher codes also run the lower cases' work. Case three sets a busy flag and spins until another routine clears it, and the default case clears a pending flag and runs a further routine.

name: read_record_header_at_index
description: Checks a record index against 155 entries, opens the library file on first use and verifies its count, then seeks to the record and reads its length. It returns the record length plus a fixed header size of 28.

name: dispatch_indexed_section_entry
description: Looks up an entry in a section table using a stored index, rebuilding that section's list when the index has changed, then jumps to a routine addressed through a second table.

name: copy_region_and_wait_frames
description: Copies a block of bytes from a table into a destination, then waits sixteen times, making two timing calls on each pass. The routine references the graphics library's frame-wait call.

name: run_five_setup_steps
description: Makes five calls to other routines in sequence, one of which is a library-vector stub, and does nothing else.

name: poll_input_and_fire_button
description: Drains an input message port, latching a key code from one message class. It then samples the fire-button bit and returns 32 on a fresh press, otherwise the latched code or 255 when no press is pending.

name: configure_cia_timer_interrupt
description: Sets control bits in the CIA-A timer control register and then calls two interrupt routines, with the values 1 and 129.

name: stop_cia_timer_interrupt
description: Calls one interrupt routine with the value one and then clears bit zero of the CIA-A control register.

name: load_cia_timer_count
description: Writes bytes taken from the upper half of its 32-bit argument into the CIA-A timer count registers.

name: remove_cia_interrupt_handler
description: When the stored handle is zero, removes an interrupt vector through the interrupt library and then calls one further routine.

name: add_cia_interrupt_handler
description: Opens the CIA-A resource and sets up an interrupt structure pointing to this handler with fixed priority bytes, then adds it as an interrupt vector. When the add reports zero it calls a cleanup routine and returns one, otherwise zero.

name: tick_channels_and_update_flags
description: On each tick, if the skip flag is set it clears it and returns. Otherwise a tick counter wraps modulo a divisor when armed, each of four channels with a pending countdown is decremented or has its level recomputed from a table, and a status word is set according to whether any channel remains active.

name: match_key_sequence_input
description: Waits for input events and compares key codes against a stored zero-terminated sequence, tracking progress through it. It sets a result word when the sequence has been matched and then returns.

name: draw_colour_wheel_prompt
description: Clears the display, sets pen colours and loads a palette, then draws text fragments that tell the reader to line up the inner and outer wheels with a colour in a box. It stores a value derived from the current time modulo 30 and returns it.

name: clear_rast_port
description: Calls the graphics library's raster-fill routine, which clears the rast port to one colour, and returns.

name: build_row_address_table
description: Writes two header words and a byte count into a record, then fills a table of row start addresses at multiples of a row size offset from a base. It then calls a further routine with the remaining data.

name: init_three_fixed_bitmaps
description: Initialises three bitmaps through the graphics library with fixed size arguments of 256 and 31, 88 and 52, and 165 and 5, filling four plane pointers in each.

name: store_random_seed
description: Stores its word argument in a global 16-bit seed cell.

name: blit_bitmap_to_rastport
description: Calls the graphics library's bitmap-to-rastport blit routine through its base and returns.

name: print_intui_text_item
description: Stores the requested position, using stored defaults when the first argument is minus one, and saves the text pointer. It measures the text length through the intuition library, updates the horizontal position and prints the text item.

name: drain_matching_messages
description: Fetches the next message from a port when none is held, then replies to and discards each message whose flag bits match the mask. It finally clears one state word and sets another.

name: call_then_terminate_buffer
description: Stores its pointer argument in a global slot, calls a further routine with a stack-relative pointer, then terminates the buffer with a zero byte and returns a 16-bit status from a global slot.

name: advance_random_seed
description: Updates a 15-bit seed cell by multiplying it by 3677, adding 3 and masking the result to 15 bits.

name: check_sinus_table_loaded
description: Looks up a constant table identifier and, when the lookup is non-negative, makes two further calls. It returns true when the lookup succeeded, and the referenced text 'sinus' names the table.

name: delegate_call_wrapper
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, with no other logic.

name: test_point_in_rectangle
description: Returns one when the point given in two registers lies within the rectangle stored as four words, inclusive of both edges, and zero otherwise.

name: read_record_header_at_index
description: Checks a record index against 155 entries, opens the library file on first use and verifies its count, then seeks to the record and reads its length. It returns the record length plus a fixed header size of 28.

name: invoke_device_begin_io
description: Calls the function at a fixed negative offset of the device base read from its request argument, which passes control to the device's begin-io routine.

name: report_unrecovered_routine_body
description: No pseudo-code could be produced for this 177-instruction routine, which is entered as a handler and runs in the reference run. Its recorded facts show only that one routine calls it, so its behaviour cannot be described from this evidence.

name: invoke_device_begin_io
description: Calls the function at a fixed negative offset of the device base read from its request argument, which passes control to the device's begin-io routine.

name: run_workbench_loader_entry
description: Program entry point that allocates a process record and opens the DOS library. When a command line is present it splits the arguments, handling quoted text and star escapes; otherwise it works from the Workbench startup message. It returns a failure code when allocation or library opening fails.

name: release_resources_and_return
description: Stores its argument as the result in a process record, then conditionally calls cleanup routines: one closes a file handle, one closes a library, and others forbid task switching and reply to a message. It calls a final cleanup routine and returns the stored result.

name: start_tool_from_resident_tag
description: XOR-decodes a global string with one key applied twice, which leaves it unchanged, and allocates a 160-byte block. It uses icon, intuition and workbench library calls, and its referenced messages include 'Cannot find resident tag for %s' and 'Cannot start tool (error %ld)'.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte and returns minus one when the first is lower, one when it is higher, and zero when they match.
